confidence_notes: Recent Gdansk cost-of-living observations support the meal, cappuccino and draft-beer estimates. Cocktail prices vary by venue and the available city sample is small; the wine-glass estimate uses its local price relationship to draft beer. Accommodation values are holistic estimates with substantial seasonal uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city was used; food and drink estimates use Gdansk-specific observations, while accommodation is estimated for a Baltic tourist city with strong seasonal demand.
